document_title: Li et al. Ocean Phenomena Dataset Benchmark Split & Evaluation Readiness

iw_mode_split_contract.sibling_leakage_firewall: MANDATORY: All slices sharing the same parent source scene stem (ranging from 1 to 51 slices) must strictly reside within the same split partition. Zero cross-split parent scene leakage.

wv_mode_split_contract.clustered_leakage_firewall: MANDATORY: Sibling Wave Mode vignettes originating from the same satellite orbit pass or calendar day must never be split across Train, Dev, and Test. Vignette-level random splitting is scientifically forbidden.

geographic_and_temporal_holdouts.geographic_basin_holdout: Candidate regional holdouts: North Atlantic, Mediterranean Sea, Western Pacific / South China Sea.
geographic_and_temporal_holdouts.temporal_holdout: Candidate pre-2020 vs post-2020 evaluation to measure detector stability across Sentinel-1 constellation lifespan.

benchmark_a_specification.task_definition: image -> phenomenon class mask (15 classes, ID 0 to 14)

input_representations.description: Direct 100m single-pol VV uint16 rasters from Li et al. (256x256)
Native Sentinel-1 Level-1 GRD dual-pol (VV+VH dB, 512x512 canonical tiles)

target_loss_functions: Multi-Class Cross-Entropy Loss with class weighting
Focal Loss (gamma=2.0) to address extreme class imbalance
Lovasz-Softmax / Multi-Class Dice Loss for phenomenon boundary optimization
primary_metrics: Mean Intersection over Union (mIoU across classes 1-14, excluding background)
Per-Class IoU for priority look-alikes (BS, LWA, IWs, OF, RC/RF, Eddy)
Boundary F1 Score (BF-Score) with 50m tolerance envelope

benchmark_b_specification.benchmark_name: EXP-06 Oil Spill Detector Phenomenon Stress-Test
benchmark_b_specification.task_definition: EXP-06 oil detector inference on confirmed ocean phenomena look-alikes
blocking_reasons: Distributed Li files are 100m single-pol VV uint16, incompatible with EXP-06 canonical dual-pol dB contract.
Direct zero-shot inference on 100m distributed files produces scientifically meaningless artifacts.
Evaluation requires recovering native 10m ESA SAFE granules, tiling to canonical 512x512, and applying frozen preprocessing.

quantity_a.definition: Count of predicted positive pixels (probability >= 0.22) divided by total evaluated pixels in patch.
quantity_a.scientific_role: Gross model activation intensity across the tile.

quantity_b.definition: Count of predicted positive pixels inside labelled phenomenon mask divided by total pixels in phenomenon mask.
quantity_b.scientific_role: Sensitivity of the oil detector to specific phenomenon dark features. NOT a false alarm rate.

quantity_c.definition: Count of predicted positive pixels outside labelled phenomenon mask divided by total evaluated non-phenomenon pixels.
quantity_c.scientific_role: Background false positive sensitivity on unannotated open ocean.

quantity_d.definition: Fraction of evaluated patches producing at least one predicted positive pixel (alarm trigger).
quantity_d.scientific_role: Patch-level alarm trigger frequency under look-alike conditions.

quantity_e.definition: Fraction of parent source scenes producing at least one alarm trigger across all child patches.

benchmark_b_specification.denominator_governance: The term False Alarm Rate (FAR) or False Positive Rate (FPR) must ONLY be used when the denominator is certified negative for oil. The ratio of positive predictions inside a look-alike mask is strictly designated PHENOMENON_REGION_RESPONSE.

scientific_limitations_summary: Limitation 1: Distributed imagery is single-pol VV only and 100m resolution; native VH channel was decimated.
Limitation 2: 100m masks projected to 10m grid are Derived High-Resolution Masks with +/-50m quantization ambiguity.
Limitation 3: Wave Mode vignettes (2,383) share orbit passes (1,678 unique passes) and cannot be split at vignette level.
Limitation 4: Li Class 14 (Oil Spill) lacks rigorous in-situ chemical verification and cannot serve as authoritative ground truth.
Limitation 5: Zero training authorized during Phase 7B.2.
